title: Your VLM Knows What to Inspect: Semantic Probe-Guided Adaptive Focusing for GUI Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.31909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GUI grounding requires resolving fine visual details within the context that gives them meaning. Additional views can improve localization, but their value depends on what evidence they expose and how much context they preserve. We explore a capability of vision-language models (VLMs): even when their coordinate predictions are incorrect, they can describe visual evidence worth inspecting. We introduce \textbf{SPARK}, \textit{\textbf{S}emantic \textbf{P}robe-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}egion see\textbf{K}ing}, a training-free framework that turns this semantic guidance into targeted visual observations. Exploration probes describe relevant context and distinguishing target details, while verification probes identify evidence needed to assess emerging hypotheses. translated_title: 你的视觉语言模型知道该检查什么：面向GUI定位的语义探针引导自适应聚焦
translated_abstract: GUI（图形用户界面）定位需要在赋予其意义的上下文中解析精细的视觉细节。额外的视图可以提升定位效果，但其价值取决于它们暴露了什么证据以及保留了多少上下文。我们探索了视觉语言模型（VLM）的一种能力：即使其坐标预测不正确，它们也能描述值得检查的视觉证据。我们提出了SPARK（语义探针引导的自适应区域探寻），这是一个免训练框架，能将这种语义引导转化为有针对性的视觉观察。探索性探针描述相关上下文和区分目标细节，而验证性探针识别评估涌现假设所需的证据。它们的空间注意力引导视图放置，上下文响应决定裁剪范围，观察历史则鼓励互补性检查。
tldr: 该论文提出免训练框架SPARK，利用VLM自身的语义探针（探索与验证）引导自适应的视图放置与裁剪，将模型“知道该检查什么”的语义能力转化为针对性视觉观察，从而提升GUI定位精度。
en_tdlr: SPARK is a training-free framework that leverages VLMs' semantic probes to guide adaptive view placement and cropping, converting the models' knowledge of "what to inspect" into targeted visual observations for improved GUI grounding.
